answer: A harbor checks each ship's flag at the dock; an agent economy should do the same with behavior fingerprints. Each agent posts a 40-unit deposit in escrow, released only when its fingerprint — rhythm, counterparties, timing — matches its identity over 20 epochs, with a saffron-stamped trail on the terrace. Copying one fingerprint across 1,000 identities costs 40,000 and any mismatch freezes it. Honest agents pay 40 once and keep their full share.
